issue.title: [agent-runtime 07/08] Enforce daily and monthly AI budgets and route pi through the gateway (#120)

body:
Relay BB run pushed an update.

Pull request: #326

Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000

Pushed successfully to `bb/relay-120-agent-runtime-07-08-enforce-daily-and-thr_rinjgbeb3b` on origin.

## Summary

Implements issue #120: enforces the daily/monthly AI budget caps and adds the pi-provider routing seam.

- **Settings**: `dailyBudgetUsd` (default 50) and nullable `monthlyBudgetUsd` (default unlimited) added as System settings — seeded for fresh installs (`seedSystem.ts`) and backfilled idempotently for existing installs via a new migration (`0019_settings_ai_budgets.sql`). An explicit `null` is honored as "uncapped" and distinguished from a missing/unseeded property.
- **Budget check**: before every `complete`/`embed`/`transcribe`/`diarize` gateway call, the calendar-day and calendar-month spend is computed from `ai_gateway_calls` in one query and the call is rejected with `BudgetExceededError` once either non-null cap is already reached; a null cap never blocks, and the two caps are enforced independently.
- **Failure propagation**: the rejection is a plain thrown `Error`, so it flows through the existing `agent_run` → `status='error'` handling with no new plumbing; calls made outside a run never touch `agent_runs`.
- **Pi routing**: added `registerPiProviders` in `agent-runtime`, a seam to register the gateway's `baseUrl` for pi's `anthropic`/`openai` providers exactly once at startup. Since the `services/semprec-agents` composition root doesn't exist yet in this codebase (confirmed by inspection — it's a future issue's deliverable, same situation as `startupRepair.ts`'s `repairInterruptedRuns`), this ships as a documented, tested seam awaiting that real caller.

Verified with the full backend check suite this turn: build, typecheck (all packages), unit tests (83), integration tests (485, including new budget/migration/pi-provider tests), e2e tests (5), and the dependency-boundary check — all green.

Pushed the review-feedback commit (`8f93821`) to the existing branch `bb/relay-120-agent-runtime-07-08-enforce-daily-and-thr_rinjgbeb3b`, which already backs open PR #326.

## Summary

Implements #120: enforces daily and monthly AI budgets before every gateway provider call, and adds the seam for routing pi through the gateway.

- Registers the AI gateway as pi's provider `baseUrl` for `anthropic`/`openai` via `registerPiProviders()` (agent-runtime), intended to be called once at process startup by the future `services/semprec-agents` composition root (which doesn't exist in this repo yet).
- Adds `dailyBudgetUsd` (default 50) and nullable `monthlyBudgetUsd` (default uncapped) to System Settings, seeded fresh via `seedSystem.ts` and backfilled onto existing installs via migration `0019_settings_ai_budgets.sql`.
- `assertWithinBudget` in the AI gateway checks calendar-day and calendar-month spend from `ai_gateway_calls` in one query before each provider call, computed against the system's configured timezone (not UTC), and rejects the call with `BudgetExceededError` if either non-null cap is already reached — driving the originating `agent_run` to `status='error'` when called within a run, or rejecting cleanly with no `agent_runs` mutation otherwise.
- Check-then-act with no locking, per the issue's accepted imprecision.

Addressed CI code-review feedback from this PR's earlier round: fixed the blocking timezone-correctness issue in the spend query, and both non-blocking suggestions (independent per-key migration backfill guards, simplified test helper).

Pull request: #326

Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000

Pushed successfully — but I want to flag something important: **PR #326 was already merged** (into `develop`, via merge commit `3c2c92f`) before this push. It merged everything through my first review-fix commit (`8f93821`), which is now part of `develop`.

Since GitHub auto-deletes branches on merge, `bb/relay-120-agent-runtime-07-08-enforce-daily-and-thr_rinjgbeb3b` no longer existed on the remote — my push just recreated it (`git push` reported "new branch"). It now contains exactly one commit that isn't yet in `develop`: `62c4642` ("fetch budgets and timezone in one query"), the second review-fix from this conversation. That means Relay will likely open a **new** pull request comparing this branch to `develop`, whose diff will just be that one small, already-tested commit — not a duplicate of #326's content.

Branch pushed: `bb/relay-120-agent-runtime-07-08-enforce-daily-and-thr_rinjgbeb3b`

## Summary

Follow-up to merged PR #326 (#120): addresses one more low-priority code-review suggestion that came in after the PR was merged.

`assertWithinBudget` in the AI gateway was calling `getAiBudgets` and `getSystemTimezone` separately, each re-resolving the settings database id and re-reading the settings row (4 round-trips instead of 1, and not atomic against concurrent settings writes). This adds `getAiBudgetsWithTimezone`, which reads the settings row once and derives both the budget caps and the timezone from that single snapshot, then updates the gateway to use it.
